# 0.0.1-dev.1: ???? (??-??-????)

## Features

- By default, the Links slide for revealjs presentations is set to scrollable to accommodate many links. ([#3](https://github.com/coatless-quarto/linkate/pull/3))
  - If there are more than 6 links, a hint "Scroll to see more links" is added to the slide.
  - If there are 6 or fewer links, no hint is added and scrolling is not necessary.

# 0.0.1: "Gotta collect them (links) all" (07-06-2025)

## Features

- `linkate` is a Quarto filter extension that automatically collects all URLs in your document and places a copy of them at the end under a "Links" section.
